definitions.gloss: outer frame; outer border; outer framework
definitions.explanation: The outermost frame of a structure, such as a window, picture, table, or screen layout. In contrast with {内枠|うちわく} (inner frame), {外枠|そとわく} encloses the whole object on the outside. Also used figuratively for the outer limits or overall framework of a plan, budget, or rule.

examples.japanese: {外枠|そとわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{黒|くろ}く→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外枠|そとわく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put a wooden frame around the outside of the photo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外枠|そとわく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さびてきた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}す⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The window's outer frame has started to rust, so we need to repaint it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外枠|そとわく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{内訳|うちわけ}→内訳：10559_uchiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}いましょう→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: The overall outline of the budget has been decided, so next let's discuss the breakdown.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ (outside) and ⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧ (frame). A straightforward compound that can refer literally to the outer border of a physical object, or figuratively to the outer boundary or overarching shape of something abstract such as a plan or rule.

USAGE:
Common in concrete contexts — construction, carpentry, framing, furniture, screen design, and graphic layout. In business contexts, {外枠|そとわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ means to fix the overall framework or limits of a project before filling in the details. In horse racing and other sports that use lane numbering, {外枠|そとわく} refers to the outside post position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外枠|そとわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to attach an outer frame
- {外枠|そとわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose with an outer frame
- {外枠|そとわく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: color of the outer frame
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外枠|そとわく}: overall / outer limit of the budget
- {外枠|そとわく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide only the overall framework
- {外枠|そとわく}{発走|はっそう}: start from the outside post (horse racing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内枠|うちわく}: inner frame — the opposite of {外枠|そとわく}; the frame on the inner side
- ⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧: frame — the general word, without specifying inner or outside
- ⟦{枠組|わくぐ}み→枠組み：13117_wakugumi⟧: framework — often used figuratively for the structure of a plan or system
- {縁|ふち}: edge; rim — the outer edge of an object, less structural than ⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧
- ⟦{輪郭|りんかく}→輪郭：14295_rinkaku⟧: outline; contour — the general shape of something seen from outside, not a physical frame
